  --numtiles NUMTILES
  --run-minutes RUN_MINUTES
  --max-dom MAX_DOM     number of active domains; controls how many per-domain
                        values are written for numtiles and history_interval*
  --history-mode {off,interval,end_d01,mid_end_d01}
                        'off' (default, timing runs): no domain writes
                        history. 'interval' (PHYSICS-GRAY fidelity
                        replicates): d01 writes a frame every --history-
                        minutes, starting at t=0; requires --history-minutes.
                        'end_d01': d01 writes only its final frame
                        (correctness runs); nested domains always get 0.
                        'mid_end_d01': d01 writes two frames, at
                        run_minutes//2 and at the end (window-frame fidelity-
                        gate input).
  --history-minutes HISTORY_MINUTES
                        required when --history-mode interval is given
  --physics-template Pxx
                        apply a physics_templates.json template id (decision
                        0051 PHYSICS-GRAY data campaign) on top of every other
                        edit, including ADIOS2, e.g. --physics-template P02
  --physics-case CASE   cases.json case id whose extra_edits (per-case paired
                        edits) are applied with --physics-template
  --set KEY=VALUE       repeatable; forces namelist scalar KEY to VALUE after
                        every other edit except ADIOS2, e.g. --set max_dom=2
                        --set restart=.false.
  --delete-key KEY      repeatable; delete every line assigning this namelist
                        key (case-insensitive, any group), e.g. --delete-key
                        opt_run
  --nest-history-on     keep history-interval writes for nested domains
                        (default: nested domains get 0, d01 gets the run
                        length)
  --no-adios2           disable ADIOS2 I/O settings (default: on). Legacy
                        behaviour: io_form_history forced to 2, nothing else
                        about I/O touched.
  --ranks RANKS         MPI rank count; required unless --no-adios2 is given
                        (adios2_numaggregators MUST equal the rank count)
  --numtiles-x N        &domains numtiles_x (WTune D1 decomposition-space
                        work); not written at all when omitted
  --numtiles-y N        &domains numtiles_y; not written at all when omitted
  --tile-sz-x N         &domains tile_sz_x (overrides numtiles entirely,
                        frame/module_tiles.F:353); not written at all when
                        omitted
  --tile-sz-y N         &domains tile_sz_y; not written at all when omitted
  --tile-strategy N     &domains tile_strategy (TILE_NONE=0 TILE_X=1 TILE_Y=2
                        TILE_XY=3, module_machine.F:11); not written at all
                        when omitted
  --restart-from YYYY-MM-DD_HH:MM:SS
                        WTune probe multi-point (2026-09-26): this is a
                        RANKING-PROBE run that starts from an existing WRF
                        restart file at this time instead of the case's own t0
                        -- every domain's start_* is overridden to it and
                        restart is forced to .true. (see edit_namelist's
                        docstring). Not written at all when omitted (default:
                        unchanged behaviour).
  --restart-io-form N   overrides io_form_restart on EITHER a --restart-from
                        run or a --write-restart-interval run, applied after
                        --no-adios2/ADIOS2's own default (e.g. 2 for netCDF,
                        decomposition-independent -- unlike ADIOS2's io_form
                        14). Not written at all when omitted.
  --write-restart-interval MINUTES
                        the ANCHOR spin-up run that WRITES the shared restart
                        file: sets restart_interval to exactly this value
                        (restart itself is left '.false.' -- this run still
                        starts at t0). Not written at all when omitted.
  --run-seconds S       exact sub-minute tail added to --run-minutes
                        (POINT_FUSED / WINDOW_EXACT: window = STEPS*dt, not
                        rounded up to whole minutes). Only with --history-mode
                        off. Not written when 0 (default).
